_excluded_categories._methodology: Grouped exclusion summary per the §3.0 registry inclusion test (docs/methodology.md, 'Registry inclusion test (278-sourced entities)'). Entities in these categories are disclosed on this filing but are not given individual cp_entity registry records, per the procurement-relevance test. Counts marked approximate were grouped by category during the Fork D §3 inspection; residential-rental and instrument lines were not itemized one entity at a time. Recorded by Fork D §4.3 step 6.

categories.rationale: Foreign-operating entities whose business activities are conducted entirely outside US jurisdiction; excluded under the §4.0.B amendment to the §3.0 inclusion test (docs/methodology.md). These seven DT-prefixed Bali/Dubai/Lido hotel, golf, and technical-services manager LLCs cannot receive US federal civilian contracts and have no plausible USAspending/SAM.gov/GSA match.
Mortgages on the filer's primary personal residence; excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(i). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Loans secured by a personal motor vehicle, household furniture, or appliances (unless the loan exceeds the item's purchase price); excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(ii). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Credit card and revolving charge account balances under $10,000 outstanding to a single creditor at the end of the reporting period; excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(iii). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Interpersonal loans from a spouse, parent, sibling, or child of the filer (natural-person counterparty only); excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(iv). Does NOT apply to entity-mediated debt (e.g., loans from a family-controlled trust or LLC), which are written as normal debt_instrument_owed edges per Convention 5. No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).
